result:
Everything checks out. Here's what I found and fixed.

## The core problem

This SaaS pivoted from **InboxZap** (email/inbox cleanup) to **Lumina** (AI meeting assistant), and the migration was left half-done:

- **`layout.tsx`'s `<title>`/meta description/OG tags still said "InboxZap"** while every page's actual content was about Lumina — anyone finding the site via search saw a snippet for a completely different product.
- **Nav/CTA linked to `/features` and `/pricing`**, which didn't exist as pages — dead links on every page, and dead entries in the sitemap.
- **`/faq` redirected to `/#faq`**, an anchor that didn't exist on the homepage.
- **The blog was a client-only component fetching `/api/posts`**, a route that was never built — so `/blog` never rendered any content for users *or* crawlers.
- **12 indexed blog posts (`/blog/post-1`...`post-12`)** are 100% old InboxZap content (Gmail filters, inbox zero, bulk-unsubscribing) with zero relevance to the new product. GSC shows them still pulling real impressions (up to 3,900) but at position 42–58 — invisible, and actively confusing anyone who does click through.

## What I changed

- **`app/layout.tsx`** — fixed title/description/OG to Lumina, added `Organization` JSON-LD with `alternateName: "InboxZap"` so search engines connect the rebrand instead of treating it as an unrelated site.
- **`app/features/page.tsx`**, **`app/pricing/page.tsx`** — built the missing pages the nav/CTA/sitemap already pointed to.
- **`app/page.tsx`** — added a brief "Formerly InboxZap" bridge section (captures residual brand-name searches honestly) and a real FAQ section with `id="faq"` + `FAQPage` JSON-LD, matching the existing redirect.
- **Blog rebuilt as real SSG**: `lib/posts.ts` (4 new posts targeting actual Lumina buyer-intent topics: the rebrand explainer, meeting summary template, action items vs. decisions, AI vs. manual notes) + server-rendered `app/blog/page.tsx` + `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` with per-post metadata and `Article` JSON-LD. No more dependency on the nonexistent API.
- **`next.config.js`** — 301-redirects the 12 dead InboxZap post URLs to `/blog` instead of letting them 404.
- **`app/sitemap.ts`** — now lists the real pages and all four new posts instead of a TODO stub.

Verified with a full `next build` + `next start`: all routes return 200, both redirects fire (308), the sitemap is well-formed, and the homepage title now correctly reads "Lumina — AI Meeting Notes & Summaries for Teams." One unrelated item worth flagging: `next@14.2.5` has a known security advisory (npm warned on install) — separate from SEO, but worth a bump when convenient.
